title: Frank & Atticus – Peppermint White Choc Cookie 100ml
description:
Frank & Atticus – Peppermint White Choc Cookie 100ml
The new Frank & Atticus Peppermint White Choc Cookie is a delectable treat for cookie lovers. This fresh vape is inspired by our local favourite ‘Mint Slice’ biscuit and consists of a buttery shortbread cookie and milk chocolate with delicious peppermint undertones.
On the inhale, you’ll get just the proper amount of sweet, rounded peppermint and milk chocolate to delight your taste senses. As the freshness fades, silky milk notes emerge, carrying the rich chocolate to a flawlessly balanced chewy sugar cookie finish.
Frank & Atticus vape juices come in 100ml bottles with 0MG nicotine. If you love dessert e-liquids, the Frank & Atticus juice range is a must-try!
